faces.transcription:
This is a pursuit objective.
To set it up, place a Pursuit token in London.
Then, place this card onto the board in the Operations area and flip it over.

OCTOBER OBJECTIVE 2
HUNT DOWN THE SOVIET “EXPORTER”
Remove the last Pursuit token from the board
STARTING CITY: LONDON
DESTINATION: ANY SOVIET CITY
Completed: Read Debrief 101
Failed (First half of month): Read Debrief 172
Failed (Second half of month): Read Debrief 241
